dedupe_keys.name: a solar power plant site screening pipeline from open satellite data and physics based reanalysis

description: A Solar Power Plant Site Screening Pipeline from Open Satellite Data and Physics Based Reanalysis is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Joel V George. "Selecting suitable land is a critical step in developing large-scale solar photovoltaic (PV) plants. Poor site selection can lead to low energy yield, high construction costs, and long-term operational issues. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
